name: sw-qa
description: Software QA skill for AI coding agents: when asked to verify that software works, the agent finds what needs testing from the commit history, the CI pipeline and the code, runs standard and domain-specific QA cases against the running software, measures test adequacy with mutation-gate, and reports defects and a go/no-go verdict with evidence. Works in Claude Code, Codex and other agents that load Agent Skills. English and Korean.
